title: Xuanfang Hold

{{Stub}} {{Location Infobox |title = Xuanfang Hold |image = Xuanfang Hold.png |type = Region |type2 = City |type3 = Huanglong City{{!}}Huanglong Cities |map = Solaris-3 |event = |nation = Huanglong }} '''Xuanfang Hold''' is a [[region]] of the [[Mengzhou]] Province in [[Huanglong]], and the primary settlement of the frontier region of Xuanfang. It is located between the cities of Mengzhou and [[Jinzhou]], and is considered a vital passageway between them. Before the founding of Jinzhou, Xuanfang Hold was established north of the Clouded Cliffs by Sentinel [[Hsin]] and Mengzhou's frontier court to contain and divide the [[Tacet Discord]] outbreak flowing from [[Norfall Barrens]]. It was built atop the ruins of Yuan Fortress after its destruction during the Fortress and Gorges War in collaboration with the [[Court of Savantae]]. One of its mountains is said to have a reclusive martial arts master living at the peak.Glossary ==Areas== {| class="article-table alternating-colors-table tdc1" style="width: 100%;" ! style="width: 200px;" |Name !
